headline: FIVE PLACES FOR A WILD ATLANTIC ESCAPE
dek: Remote villages, sea cliffs and island days
caption:
A trip to the Faroe Islands is more than a collection of viewpoints. It's the kind of adventure you plan with friends who don't mind getting a bit windswept. 🌊

⛴ Ferry over to Kalsoy, then take the hike from Trøllanes towards Kallur lighthouse.
🥾 Follow the old village path between Saksun and Tjørnuvík, looking down over the lagoon.
🏡 Walk the historic trail from Funningur to Gjógv before finding its natural sea gorge.
🏄 Make time for Tjørnuvík's beach and Atlantic surf.
🌿 Take the Trælanípa cliff walk for that extraordinary lake-above-the-ocean view.

These are separate outings on different islands, not a one-day route. Check ferry schedules, weather and any hiking fees or guided-access arrangements before planning.

Send this to the friend you'd take along, or save it for a wild Atlantic escape. 🗺️

Photos: Marc Zimmer, Polina Kuzovkova, Annie Spratt, Himmel S & Sebastian Boring / Unsplash.
